loadError.title: Couldn't load badges
loadError.hint: Something went wrong while fetching this learner's badges.

disabledBanner.text: Badges are turned off for this institute. Awards are saved, but learners won't see them or be notified until badges are enabled in Settings → Badges & Rewards (parents with portal access see them immediately).

picker.label: Badge
picker.empty: No badges available to award yet.

preview.autoHeldHint: This learner already auto-unlocked this badge. Awarding it records it as a staff award with your note.

award.heading: Award a badge
award.empty: No badges configured yet. Add them in Settings → Badges & Rewards first.
award.notePlaceholder: e.g. Top scorer in the unit test — the learner sees this with the badge
award.toastNotEnrolled: This learner is not a member of this institute, so the badge was not awarded.
award.toastNotNotified: Learners are not notified while badges are turned off

awarded.heading: Awarded badges
awarded.emptyHint: Recognise this learner with a badge above.

revoke.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
revoke.manualBody: The learner loses this badge; the record is kept for audit.
revoke.autoBody: This removes it from leaderboards, stats and the parent view. The learner's own app may still show it as unlocked while the rule is met.

create.title: Create a new badge
create.intro: Staff award this badge from a learner's profile or the students list. Each learner can hold a badge once — for recurring recognition create dated or tiered variants.
create.duplicateWarning: An enabled badge named "{{name}}" already exists. You can still create this one.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this badge recognises — learners see it with the badge.
create.hiddenHelp: Learners don't see this badge until they earn it. Applies on updated learner apps.
create.errorToast: Couldn't create the badge. Try again.
